mechanics: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ177, "Warped Sense of Justice," associated with Goku (Mini)'s Power Pole moveset. The user rushes forward, strikes, kicks the opponent away, and chases them; holding the fly input improves the forward dash and permits an immediate follow-up. Current evidence classifies it as a two-hit rush and preserves the documented follow-up behavior without inferring unsupported damage or frame data.
evidence_boundary: Numerical values are source-reported observations. Exact frames, universal scaling, hidden interactions, and reward probabilities are not asserted without direct evidence.
